note: PuLID-Flux identity still: LoadImage(10) is the character's primary portrait and feeds ApplyPulidFlux(23), which patches the Flux model before KSampler(7). 'image' and 'reference' are two names for the same single-portrait input and both land on node 10, so a job must set only one of them. The identity strength (0.9), start/end window, Flux guidance and sampler settings are fixed graph literals rather than job parameters; CCL2c selects this workflow for a character whose visual.identity.method is 'pulid'. No URLs, credentials or local paths: the identity model files are installed by the separate model lock (CCL2b).
